title: Six Things in a Box
subtitle: 互助关爱 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）
meta: 主题语境：互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）　|　核心词汇：aid　|　正文 323 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 aid 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 my aunt gave ① first aid to nine people in one afternoon, in a room behind the church, and said afterwards that she had done nothing any of them could not have done. Aid, she said, is only ever the thing somebody else cannot reach in time, and she said it for forty years without once changing the words; aid, she added, is mostly standing still.

She did it ② with the aid of a box my grandfather had made in 1946, which had six things in it and a label in his hand. There was a collection ③ in aid of the miners in 1972, and she gave nine pounds and said the phrase does not promise anything, which is why it is the honest one; aid, she said, is money that has admitted what it is.

Her ④ hearing aid, which she got in 1979 and hated, was the only thing in the house she ever apologised to. The ⑤ aid that came from the county in 1981 was six boxes and one letter, and she said an aid that arrives with a letter is a different thing from an aid that arrives with a person.

Nobody ⑥ came to her aid in 1984, when she fell, and she lay for six hours and said nothing about it for nine years. My mother said ⑦ aid is easy to give and hard to receive, and I have never decided whether that was about her or about my aunt; an aid, my mother said, is never the thing you needed.

The ⑧ aid I would name, if I named one, is my grandfather's box, which had six things in it and is still in a drawer. There was ⑨ no aid at all in the last year, though three people offered and she refused all three; the ⑩ aid she had given to nine people in one afternoon was the only thing she ever counted, and she counted it wrong.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 辅助器具（a hearing aid 助听器）
C. n. 援助物资；救援款
E. 固定搭配：in aid of ... 为帮助……；为支援

answers.why: first aid 意为“急救”，1968 年姑姑一个下午给九个人做了急救，地点在教堂后面的一间屋子里。
with the aid of ... 意为“借助、在……的帮助下”，她是借助祖父 1946 年做的一只箱子做这些事的。
in aid of ... 意为“为帮助……、为支援”，1972 年有一次为矿工募捐的活动，她捐了九英镑。
hearing aid 意为“助听器”，1979 年她配了助听器，那是屋里唯一一件她道过歉的东西。
aid 意为“援助物资”，1981 年县里送来的援助物资是六只箱子加一封信。
come to one's aid 意为“前来帮助某人”，1984 年她摔倒时没有人来帮她，她躺了六个小时。
aid 意为“帮助、援助”，母亲说帮助容易给出，却难以接受。
aid 意为“辅助物、助力”，若我说出一件，那就是祖父那只装有六样东西的箱子。
aid 意为“帮助”，最后一年她一点帮助也不肯接受，三个人提出，她全拒绝了。
aid 意为“援助”，她一个下午给九个人的援助，是她唯一数过的东西，而她还数错了。
